verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Productboard's REST API, webhooks, and MCP server capabilities, but nothing describes an interactive API reference with runnable/try-it-out examples, and a direct probe for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec (which typically powers such interactive docs) returned 404s across all standard paths, indicating no such spec is discoverable. missing for 10: any documented interactive API console, runnable code samples, or discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger UI.
